headline: Steady quarter as profit recovers from one-off hit
summary_short: Revenue rose 1.3% q/q to ₹73,188 crore and net profit rose 4.0% q/q to ₹13,884 crore; EPS was ₹38.37, up 7.4% y/y.
summary_long: Revenue from operations reached ₹73,188 crore, up 1.3% from ₹72,275 crore in the prior quarter. Net profit was ₹13,884 crore versus ₹13,349 crore, which had included a ₹668 crore exceptional loss. EPS of ₹38.37 compares with ₹36.90 last quarter and ₹35.74 a year earlier. A second interim dividend of ₹12 per share was declared. Headcount was 598,056 and trailing IT services attrition 13.3%.
confidence_notes: primary filing unreachable — KPI-only summary from verified shard data. KPI-only summary — no filing was read; drivers and guidance not assessed. Revenue and profit figures come from a PTI/IANS news report (DT Next), cross-checked against other outlets in search results; EPS comes from the shard (Yahoo). One outlet reported net profit as ₹13,934 crore; the widely reported ₹13,884 crore was used. TCS has an April-March fiscal year, so the period label FY2026 Q3 follows the shard's calendar-based labelling, not the company's own Q2 FY27 naming.
